issues.subject: Strandholt Notes, {month}: Halde Grotesk is here
issues.text:
STRANDHOLT TYPE NOTES
{month} {year}

View in your browser: https://strandholttype.example/notes/strandholt-notes-halde-grotesk-is-here

Hello from Copenhagen. Halde Grotesk, which some of you have been testing since March, is out today. Notes readers get a discount on it this month, at the bottom of this email.

NEW RELEASE

Halde Grotesk
9 weights, roman and italic, variable font included
Halde started as a sign face for a ferry company and grew into a family for text and interfaces. It has a tall x-height, open shapes that hold up at 11px, tabular figures by default in the lighter weights, and a set of arrows drawn to match the stroke. The italic is a true italic, not a slanted roman, and the variable version covers the full weight range in one file.

See the specimen: https://strandholttype.example/fonts/halde-grotesk

ALSO THIS MONTH

Vinter Serif 2.1
Free update for existing licences: better Polish and Czech accents, and a fix for the kerning of 'Te' at large sizes.

Download the update: https://strandholttype.example/fonts/vinter-serif-2-1

Type in use: the Aarhus city bus timetables
Vinter Serif at 7pt on paper, which we did not think would work. It does.

See the photos: https://strandholttype.example/fonts/type-in-use-the-aarhus-city-bus-timetables

FOR NOTES READERS

20% off Halde Grotesk until the end of {month}
Use the code NOTES20 at checkout. Desktop, web and app licences included.

Buy Halde Grotesk: https://strandholttype.example/fonts/halde-grotesk?code=NOTES20

Thanks for reading,
Signe Holm and Anders Lund
Strandholt Type

--

issues.subject: Strandholt Notes, {month}: a new specimen book
issues.text:
STRANDHOLT TYPE NOTES
{month} {year}

View in your browser: https://strandholttype.example/notes/strandholt-notes-a-new-specimen-book

Hello from Copenhagen. This month we have a printed specimen, a small update and a story about a typeface on a lighthouse.

NEW THIS MONTH

The Strandholt specimen book, second edition
Sixty-four pages showing every family we publish, printed on uncoated paper in two colours. Free to anyone with a licence, and EUR 14 otherwise to cover printing and postage. We have 500 copies.

Order a copy: https://strandholttype.example/fonts/the-strandholt-specimen-book-second-edition

Mole Mono 1.3
Adds box-drawing characters and a slashed zero as an alternate. Free update.

Download the update: https://strandholttype.example/fonts/mole-mono-1-3

TYPE IN USE

Vinter Serif on the Skagen lighthouse visitor centre
Cut into oak, at sizes we never drew it for. The studio that did the signage sent us photos and a very kind note.

See the photos: https://strandholttype.example/fonts/vinter-serif-on-the-skagen-lighthouse-visitor-centre

Thanks for reading,
Signe Holm and Anders Lund
Strandholt Type

issues.subject: Strandholt Notes, {month}: Mole Mono and a trial licence
issues.text:
STRANDHOLT TYPE NOTES
{month} {year}

View in your browser: https://strandholttype.example/notes/strandholt-notes-mole-mono-and-a-trial-licence

Hello from Copenhagen. A new family for code and tables, and a change to how trial fonts work.

NEW RELEASE

Mole Mono
5 weights, roman and italic
A monospace with a slightly narrow width, so more fits on a line, and generous spacing in the punctuation so code stays readable. We drew it first for our own invoices, which tells you something about how we spend our evenings. It works well in tables of numbers too.

See the specimen: https://strandholttype.example/fonts/mole-mono

ALSO THIS MONTH

Trial fonts are now free for 60 days of client work
Use any of our trial fonts in pitches and presentations for two months, then buy a licence if the work goes ahead. Our licence page explains the details in plain language.

Read the trial terms: https://strandholttype.example/licensing/trial

Halde Grotesk preview
Four weights of our next family are available to test. Feedback welcome.

Try the preview: https://strandholttype.example/fonts/halde-grotesk-preview

FOR NOTES READERS

15% off Mole Mono this month
Code NOTES15, valid until the end of the month.

Buy Mole Mono: https://strandholttype.example/fonts/mole-mono?code=NOTES15

Thanks for reading,
Signe Holm and Anders Lund

issues.subject: Strandholt Notes, {month}: Vinter Serif gets a display cut
issues.text:
STRANDHOLT TYPE NOTES
{month} {year}

View in your browser: https://strandholttype.example/notes/strandholt-notes-vinter-serif-gets-a-display-cut

Hello from Copenhagen. A display version of our oldest family, and a note about the studio moving floors.

NEW RELEASE

Vinter Display
4 weights, roman and italic
Vinter Serif was drawn for text at 9 to 12 points. Vinter Display is the same design tightened for headlines: finer serifs, more contrast, closer spacing. Existing Vinter Serif licence holders get Display at half price, automatically applied at checkout when you're signed in.

See the specimen: https://strandholttype.example/fonts/vinter-display

ALSO THIS MONTH

We've moved up two floors
Same building, more light, and a room for the proof press. If you're in Copenhagen, come and see us on a Friday afternoon.

Type in use: a cookbook from Bornholm
Vinter Serif and Halde Grotesk together, which we hadn't tried ourselves.

See the spreads: https://strandholttype.example/fonts/type-in-use-a-cookbook-from-bornholm

Thanks for reading,
Signe Holm and Anders Lund
Strandholt Type

--
